name: print-social-navy-fintech-story-set-with-store-badges
title: Navy Fintech Story Set with Store Badges
whatItIs: Three vertical stories: a woman with headphones under a cloudy sky, a translucent blue card, and a glass dollar orb, each with a centred navy headline and the App Store and Google Play badges.
whatItMeans: Airy pastel blues make finance feel light, and repeated headline and badge positions make the set cohesive.
techniques: Consistent story chrome and headline position
One hero object per story (person, card, orb)
Store badges anchored at the bottom
Blur and pearlescent glass rendering for objects
Blue gradient washes from the sky to white

vocabulary.definition: Official App Store or Google Play download buttons.
A translucent sphere rendered with refraction.
A sequence of vertical stories designed together.
